parameters.content:
## 🎯 What this workflow does

Every morning at 07:30 it reads the four sheets the other RozContent templates keep for you — `Leads`, `Appointments`, `Invoices` and `Orders` — and emails you ONE plain-text digest: new leads from the last 24 hours, today's appointments, overdue invoices with the total outstanding, and yesterday's orders with revenue. If anything needs action (an overdue invoice, or appointments today) the subject line is flagged 🔔.

**Follow the sticky notes in order: SETUP first, then test, then activate.**

Built by RozContent — free template. The paid version adds a WhatsApp digest, charts and trends week-on-week, and one combined dashboard sheet kept up to date for you.

## 🛠️ SETUP — do these before activating

1. **Point the four read nodes at YOUR sheets.** Each read node has its own sheet-ID field (`PASTE_YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID`) — the four tabs can live in one spreadsheet or four different ones. Tabs must be named exactly `Leads`, `Appointments`, `Invoices` and `Orders` (the README has the mapping table: which template creates which tab, with exact headers).
2. **Credentials:** click each Google Sheets node (×4) and Gmail node (×2) and connect YOUR Google account. The placeholder credentials in this file are dummies — n8n will prompt you.
3. **CONFIG node:** set `config_business_name`, `config_owner_email` (the digest goes there) and `config_currency` (the symbol shown before invoice amounts, e.g. `$`, `£`, `PKR `).
4. **Timezone:** in the workflow's Settings (top-right ⋯ menu) set the timezone to YOUR business timezone — "today", "yesterday" and the 07:30 start all use it.
5. **Missing a tab? Leave it.** Every read is set to continue on error — a sheet you don't use yet is simply skipped and its section reads as empty. See Production Notes.
6. **Test** by executing the workflow manually (README) and checking the first digest against your sheets by hand before switching Active on.

## ⚠️ Production notes (read once)

- ⚠️ **How the four reads combine:** Google Sheets "get" nodes replace the items in the chain, they don't merge. So the four reads run in sequence and the single `Build the Digest` Code node pulls each one back by name — `$('Read Leads').all()`, `$('Read Appointments').all()` and so on. Don't rename the read nodes without updating that Code node.
- ⚠️ **Any sheet you don't use yet is simply skipped.** All four reads use "continue on error" with the error output left unconnected, and the Code node treats a failed read as zero rows. Honest flip side: a tab that fails because of a typo'd name or a wrong sheet ID is ALSO skipped silently — check your first few digests against the sheets by hand.
- ⚠️ **Garbage in, garbage out.** The digest is only as good as the sheets behind it. A lead with no Timestamp, an invoice never marked Paid, an appointment typed as `20/10/2026` — the digest cannot fix any of that.
- ⚠️ **The money figures are simple sums, not accounting.** No partial payments, no refunds, no tax, and no currency conversion: order revenue is summed per currency symbol exactly as typed in the sheet.
- ⚠️ Emails send from the Gmail account you connect. Use the inbox you actually read at breakfast.
